projects.title: IoT Learning Kit
projects.description: Developed an educational IoT kit using ESP32, featuring real-time sensor data collection and cloud integration for teaching IoT concepts.

projects.title: Fast Line Following with PID
projects.description: A high-speed line-following robot powered by an ESP32, featuring 500 RPM gear motors, adaptive line detection, and Bluetooth-based PID tuning.

projects.title: Hello World to TinyML
projects.description: A classic Hello World example for embedded machine learning, involving training a neural network and deploying it on a microcontroller using TFLM.

projects.title: Smart Medibox
projects.description: Created a smart medication dispenser with IoT capabilities, featuring automated reminders and remote monitoring using ESP32.

projects.title: Virtual Drawing with AI
projects.description: This system allows users to draw with hand gestures and receive AI-generated answers based on the drawing using computer vision.
